a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.intro: Changes apply straight away, on every page.

quick.label: Comfort settings
quick.preview: Tonight: pasta with a few peas on the side, and a no-thank-you bite of broccoli.

reducedMotion.label: Reduce motion
reducedMotion.description: Stops slides, fades and moving decorations.

dyslexiaFont.label: Easier-to-read font
dyslexiaFont.description: A rounder font with more space between letters and lines.

groups.moreHint: Focus outlines, a flatter look, page announcements and keyboard shortcuts.

extendedTimeouts.label: Keep messages on screen longer
extendedTimeouts.description: Pop-up messages stay for 12 seconds instead of 4, so there is time to read them or press Undo.

screenReaderMode.label: Move focus to the page heading on navigation
screenReaderMode.description: After you open a new page, keyboard and screen reader focus starts at its main content instead of the top of the window.

announcePageChanges.label: Announce page changes
announcePageChanges.description: Screen readers say the name of each new page you open.

enhancedFocus.label: Clearer focus outlines
enhancedFocus.description: A thicker outline around whatever the keyboard is on.

simplifiedUI.label: Flatter look (no shadows or gradients)
simplifiedUI.description: Removes drop shadows and color gradients. Nothing is hidden.

keyboardShortcuts.label: Single-key shortcuts
keyboardShortcuts.description: On the dashboard, one letter jumps to a page: T for today, G for groceries, S for the pantry, L to log a meal, ? for the list. Turn off if you use speech input or a switch device and letters fire by accident. Ctrl/Cmd + K and Escape keep working either way.

reset.hint: Keeps what your device asks for, such as reduced motion.

statement.title: Need help?
statement.body: If something in EatPal is hard to use, tell us and we will fix it or find another way.
